nodes.label: Role-Agent Framework
nodes.rationale: Single LLM functioning as both agent and environment for bootstrapped co-evolution via World-In-Agent (WIA) state prediction and Agent-In-World (AIW) failure mode analysis.

nodes.label: World-In-Agent (WIA) Module
nodes.rationale: LLM predicts future states at each step; predictive reward computed via Longest Matching Subsequence (LMS) similarity; modulates task reward to encourage environment-aware reasoning.

nodes.label: Agent-In-World (AIW) Module
nodes.rationale: LLM analyzes failed trajectories to extract failure modes; retrieves tasks with similar failure patterns from offline history; reshapes training data distribution for targeted practice.

nodes.label: State-Level Advantage Computation
nodes.rationale: Groups identical states across rollout batch; computes state-level advantages independent of temporal ordering; combines with trajectory-level advantages via coefficient α for final advantage signal.

nodes.label: ALFWorld and WebShop Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Interactive text-based environments: ALFWorld tests multi-step household tasks; WebShop simulates e-commerce with 1.18M products; Role-Agent achieves 90.9% and 71.9% success rates respectively.

nodes.label: Search-Augmented QA Tasks
nodes.rationale: Single-hop (NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA) and multi-hop (HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, Bamboogle) QA datasets; Role-Agent achieves 45.8% average, with +8.2% on 2Wiki and +5.2% on MuSiQue.

nodes.label: Failure Mode Library
nodes.rationale: 11 unique failure modes on ALFWorld (repetitive exploration, wrong target location, entity confusion, etc.); accumulated during training; enables targeted retrieval of similar tasks for practice.

nodes.label: GiGPO Baseline
nodes.rationale: State-grouped RL method achieving 86.7% on ALFWorld and 83.1% on WebShop; Role-Agent outperforms with 4.2% and 6.9% relative gains respectively.

hyperedges.label: Agent-Environment Co-Evolution
hyperedges.rationale: Single LLM bootstraps through dual-role evolution: WIA enables agent to predict environment dynamics and learn environment-aware reasoning; AIW enables environment to analyze agent failures and reshape training distribution; failure modes library enables targeted practice on historical deficiencies.
